items.source: Constructor with an initialized HttpClient and a DataBufferFactory.
items.translation: 带有已初始化的HttpClient和DataBufferFactory的构造函数。

items.source: Constructor with a JdkHttpClientResourceFactory that provides shared resources.
items.translation: 带有 `JdkHttpClientResourceFactory` 的构造函数，该工厂提供共享资源。

items.source: By default, this is DefaultDataBufferFactory.sharedInstance.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是DefaultDataBufferFactory.sharedInstance。

items.source: By default, HttpCookie.parse(String) is used, and additionally the sameSite attribute is parsed and set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用HttpCookie.parse(String)，并且还会解析并设置相同的 sameSite 属性。

items.source: ClientHttpConnector for the Java HttpClient.
items.translation: ClientHttpConnector 用于 Java HttpClient。

items.source: Connect to the origin server using the given HttpMethod and URI and apply the given requestCallback when the HTTP request of the underlying API can be initialized and written to.
items.translation: 使用给定的 `HttpMethod` 和 `URI` 连接到源服务器，并在底层 API 的 HTTP 请求可以初始化并写入时应用给定的 `requestCallback`。

items.source: Default constructor that uses HttpClient.newHttpClient().
items.translation: 使用 HttpClient.newHttpClient() 的默认构造函数。

items.source: resourceFactory - the JdkHttpClientResourceFactory to use
items.translation: `resourceFactory` - 要使用的JdkHttpClientResourceFactory

items.source: clientBuilder - a pre-initialized builder for the client that will be further initialized with the shared resources to use
items.translation: clientBuilder - 一个已预初始化用于构建客户端的构建器，该客户端将使用共享资源进行进一步初始化。

items.source: Julien Eyraud, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Julien Eyraud, Rossen Stoyanchev

items.source: Default is the system's default timeout.
items.translation: 默认值为系统的默认超时时间。

items.source: Description copied from interface: ClientHttpConnector
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：ClientHttpConnector

items.source: Set the underlying HttpClient read timeout as a Duration.
items.translation: 将底层的HttpClient读取超时设置为Duration。

items.source: Set the buffer factory to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的缓冲区工厂。

items.source: Customize the parsing of response cookies.
items.translation: 自定义响应 Cookie 的解析方式。

items.source: requestCallback - a function that prepares and writes to the request, returning a publisher that signals when it's done writing. Implementations can return a Mono<Void> by calling ReactiveHttpOutputMessage.writeWith(Publisher) or ReactiveHttpOutputMessage.setComplete().
items.translation: requestCallback - 一个准备并向请求写入数据的函数，返回一个在写入完成时发出信号的 Publisher。实现可以通过调用 ReactiveHttpOutputMessage.writeWith(Publisher) 或 ReactiveHttpOutputMessage.setComplete() 返回一个 Mono<Void>。

items.source: connect in interface ClientHttpConnector
items.translation: `connect` 接口 `ClientHttpConnector` 中

items.source: publisher for the ClientHttpResponse
items.translation: `ClientHttpResponse` 接口的发布者。

items.source: parser - the parser to use
items.translation: parser - 要使用的解析器

items.source: method - the HTTP request method
items.translation: method - HTTP 请求方法

items.source: uri - the HTTP request URI
items.translation: uri - HTTP 请求 URI
